name: rummage_bin
text: A standing person searches a waist-high bin. Keep both feet planted, hips near standing height and knees only slightly bent. Start upright. Lean forward from the hips, rest the left hand on the rim and search down inside with the right hand. Only the right forearm enters the bin; head and shoulders stay above and outside the mouth. Withdraw the right hand, lift the left hand off the rim, and finish fully standing upright with both hands by the thighs. Do not squat or kneel.

scene.text: Standing close to a waist high open bin, bend forward at the hips with slightly bent knees, support the left hand on its rim, reach the right hand down inside, slowly search side to side, withdraw the hand and straighten.
scene.description: The person starts at trash_bin.post_rummage and faces the model standing marker direction. LeftHand touches rim_left at 1.00s,4.00s. RightHand touches search_right at 1.75s,3.25s. repair.reason: Old motion stayed crouched inside the bin during lid closure. Regenerated with upright start/end and retained standing search keyframes.
repair.actual_stage_review: Complete 150-sample assembled sequence inspected in three views: lid opens, shallow search, hands/head withdraw, lid closes; no head/bin or lid intersection seen. Sequential still frames, not real-time video.
